type get_molecule_profile = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

smiles: string,

ph?: number

// SMILES string (may contain salts).
smiles: string

smiles: string

type find_similar_molecules_CYP2C9_Substrate_CarbonMangels = (_: {
// SMILES string of the query molecule.
smiles: string

Context: CYP P450 2C9 plays a major role in the oxidation of both xenobiotic and endogenous compounds. Substrates are drugs that are metabolized by the enzyme.
Question: Given a drug SMILES string, predict whether it
(A) is not a substrate to the enzyme CYP2C9 (B) is a substrate to the enzyme CYP2C9
Drug SMILES: CCCCN1CCCC[C@H]1C(=O)Nc1c(C)cccc1C
